name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view: newest segment cards first with editable titles, drag to reorder, merge selected segments, AI improve one or all, click an index to select, image chips with automatic file cleanup, pending-count badges on the hidden button and the sidebar workspace, batch insert / replace / send, archive management, resizable panel and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗：新分段置顶且标题可编辑，可拖拽排序、合并选中分段、AI 优化单段或全部、点击序号选中，图片芯片删除时自动清理磁盘文件，隐藏按钮与侧边栏工作区显示未发送数量角标，支持单段/多段插入、替换与发送，发送自动归档，归档可显示隐藏和恢复删除，可调整尺寸并适配深色模式。
author: RestRegular
